assertions.name: backup-freshness

assertions.name: clickhouse-backup-restore

assertions.name: collision-refusal

assertions.name: convergence-noop-removal

assertions.name: drift-classification
assertions.summary: Status separated application B's kubectl-patch configuration drift from scenario-retire's retained orphans; the strict replan refused the foreign field manager and was closed by abandon-refused-operation, and the --take-over-fields replan restored the reviewed bytes under the same UID with Nagare as sole field manager

assertions.name: independent-scope-preservation

assertions.name: interrupted-recovery

assertions.name: postgresql-backup-restore

assertions.name: redis-backup-restore

assertions.name: retained-data
